name: coding-agent-skills
description: Reusable skills for choosing a coding agent and model with project-specific routing rules and delegating through native CLI adapters.
shortDescription: Choose and delegate to a coding agent.
longDescription: Configure which coding agent, provider, and model fit your tasks. Use the selected native CLI adapter for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Pi, fx, Antigravity, or DeepSeek Harness.
defaultPrompt: Use setup-agent-routing to configure coding-agent preferences for this project.
